issues.description: Documented `make demo` / `extract --tiny` path is not runnable from the repo because the required story dataset is absent.
`generate-stories` tries to read `data/stories/manifest.json` before generating it, so clean bootstrap fails.
Story loading assumes every configured emotion/topic/story file exists and provides no fallback despite the repo shipping no story files.
Integration fixture unconditionally runs the gated real model and missing story-data pipeline, making `make test-all` unsuitable for normal CI.
The only story-data test is skipped when the dataset is absent, masking the clean-checkout failure.
`all_token_activations` stacks all layers/tokens for a batch on CPU, which can create very large memory spikes with Gemma-scale settings.
Neutral activation extraction always drops token position 0 as BOS, which is wrong for tokenizers that do not insert a BOS token.
Story generation performs network calls with no timeout, retry, or API error handling, so a bad endpoint can hang indefinitely.
Preference scoring depends on isolated single-token `A`/`B` encodings, which is brittle for context-sensitive or leading-space tokenization.
Bradley-Terry fitting uses fixed-step gradient descent without stable sigmoid/log clipping, risking overflow or non-convergence on stronger preferences.
Emotion vector extraction silently produces NaNs if any configured emotion has zero loaded stories.
PCA component selection divides by total variance without handling zero-variance inputs.
Checked-in generated outputs claim an 80-story run, but the source story dataset is absent, making artifacts unverifiable.
Build metadata is checked into source control, creating stale packaging state that should be regenerated by the build.
